wayback._eras_note: HV's archive straddles two domains and six site generations, none of which fits a generic era parser: holtzbrinck-ventures.com 2006-2010 (phpwcms, per-company pages index.php?<key>_en whose subnav carries the whole Portfolio or Exits list, section read from levelsensitive_active_link), 2011-2015 (Dutyfarm CMS, the pf-teaser grid of <a href=index.php?<key> title=Name> on every portfolio page, Current vs Former read from the submenu act_path), 2015-2018 (WordPress /portfolio/ and /filterportfolio/), then hvcapital.com 2020-2021 (WordPress Divi /companies) and 2022-2025 (Next.js /_next/data/<build>/companies.json, the Storyblok companiesListingData with entry_date, founded_date, partners, city, country, current_stage). scratch/hv_archive.py reads the raw captures under sources/wayback/raw/ and writes sources/wayback/parsed/<year>.json in wayback-pull's shape, every row carrying its exact capture_url (COLLECTION.md s1: a capture URL is a valid citation). Proposed write-back: a query-string per-company-page era type and a Next.js _next/data JSON era type for wayback-pull.py.

roster._note: The roster is curated (sources/wayback/partner-roster.json) from the live team pages (hvcapital.com/team/<slug>, 67 in the 2026 sitemap), the old site's team pages (holtzbrinck-ventures.com index.php?<firstlast>_en 2006-2015, with the 2007 facts page naming the managing directors), the Form ADV Schedule A owners of both advisers, and the portfolio records' own deal-partner fields (the 2022-2025 Storyblok partners and the live CSV).

site_api._entry_stage_note: The firm's own export carries 'Stage at Entry' (early / growth). Eligible by semantics (the firm's claim about the stage at which IT entered, beside HV Entry), but 'early' straddles Pre-Seed, Seed and Series A and is an anchor like a bare year (COLLECTION.md s5, stage_words); only 'growth' collapses onto one stage. The field is scored blind against the book's documented rounds before it labels (decisions.md); until then entry_stage_fields stays empty and the value rides in the item as evidence.
site_api._note: hvcapital.com is Next.js App Router on the Storyblok CMS (space 330117); the company table is streamed client-side and paged by a server action, but the page's own export button (PortfolioExportButton) calls /api/portfolio-csv, which returns the whole list as CSV. Escalation ladder step 4 (the SPA's own endpoint), read 2026-09-29.
site_api._team_note: hvcapital.com/team (Storyblok): 66 people in six departments; the Operations department (32: finance, legal, fund operations) is left unmapped so it does not publish; titles from each person page's positionField (sources/site/team-cards.json). The site publishes no social links.
site_api._entry_stage_score: Scored 2026-09-29 at the taxonomy level against each row's documented entry round (decisions.md D11): of the 17 export rows labelled 'growth' whose entry round the record documents, 16 were Growth entries (Agreena, CarOnSale excluded as undocumented; Enpal, Exein, FMC, Flip, Flowdesk, Framer, Holidu, HOLY, KoRo, Marvel Fusion, n8n, Nabla, Quantum Systems, Roadsurfer, Solaris, Storyblok) and one was not (ARX: the growth fund bought into the EUR 31M Series A): 16/17 = 94%, below the 95% bar and under 30 rows, so the label is promoted at medium (COLLECTION.md s5). 'early' straddles Pre-Seed, Seed and Series A and stays an anchor (stage_words), never a label.
